outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic illustrating the experimental workflow, not a data plot.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b mRNA expression shows individual data points (gray, blue, red dots) overlaid on each bar (n=4 per group).
Tumor volume quantification is shown as a scatter/dot plot with mean and 95% CI overlay; individual mouse data points are directly visible.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b mRNA expression (shRNA) shows individual data points overlaid on each bar (n=4 per group).
This is a line plot of tumor volume over time with error bars (SEM); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points as overlay would make them unreadable.
Panel F includes a micrograph and a bar chart quantifying CD4 fluorescence; the bar chart displays individual data points (blue and red dots) for each condition.
Panel G includes a micrograph and a bar chart quantifying pERK fluorescence; the bar chart displays individual data points (blue and red dots) for each condition.
